history.summary: Garbled, mislabelled listing: titled 'Cheap East Coast Condo' and tagged D15, but the MRT field shows SW1 Cheng Lim LRT — which is in Sengkang (D19), not East Coast. At $1.48M / $2,643 PSF for 560sqft 99yr LH with no built year and no URA data, this is incoherent and one of the worst-scoring entries in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: score_1000 is just 247 — the lowest in the batch — and the dossier is internally contradictory (D15 label vs Cheng Lim LRT in Sengkang). $2,643 PSF for a 560sqft leasehold shoebox is extremely expensive with no project identity, no built year and zero URA data to justify it. Unidentifiable, mispriced and inconsistent: a clear Avoid.
